name: Mrs Satou
source:
Lilly's and Akira's mother is a former business journalist-turned-homemaker who accompanied her husband back to her homeland of Scotland after he was transferred there and wasted no time joining him in the corporate environment of the company he was sent to manage.

A surprisingly laid-back person for someone who married into a prestigious family, she's eager to get to know her daughter's best friends.
